title: Monthly Charging of Cable, Telephone and Oxygen Concentrator Service: Ancillary and Optional Services Billing
content:
Under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing, cable television, an in-room telephone line and a non-covered oxygen concentrator are charged per service month in arrears. A service started during a month is charged for the days from the start date over the days in the month; a cancelled service is charged through the end of the month in which the cancellation was requested, and a discharge ends it on the discharge date. A recurring service is charged only while the account is open. A service month is charged once per service.

## The two conditions on a monthly charge

| Condition | What the company's records must show before the month is charged |
|---|---|
| Account open | The ancillary account the month is charged to is open |
| Once per month and service | No charge already posted to that account for the same service month and the same recurring service |

Both conditions rest on the account and ledger records, not on a statement. The same month may carry one charge for cable television and one for the telephone line, because each service is counted separately.

## The first, partial month

The charge for a service started during a month is the monthly charge multiplied by the number of days from the start date through the last day of that month, divided by the number of days in that month, rounded half up to the cent.

### Worked months (hypothetical start dates)

| Service and start | Days charged over days in month | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Cable television at USD 42.00 per month, started 19 April 2026 | 12 of 30 | USD 42.00 multiplied by 12, divided by 30: USD 16.80 |
| Telephone line at USD 29.00 per month, started 11 February 2026 | 18 of 28 | USD 29.00 multiplied by 18, divided by 28: USD 18.642..., rounded half up to USD 18.64 |

## Cancellation and discharge

- Cancellation requested on 6 May 2026 (hypothetical): the service is charged through 31 May 2026, the end of the month in which the cancellation was requested.
- Discharge: the service ends on the discharge date.

## Points of judgement

- **The account is pending setup or closed.** A recurring service is charged only while the account is open, so the month is not charged to it.
- **May the same month of cable television be charged twice on one account?** No; a service month is charged once per service.
- **When is a month charged?** In arrears, after the service month.
